tools.name: heartbeat
tools.description: Agent Flight Recorder — "still alive" ping for a registered monitor. Include capsule (any JSON ≤32KB: current step, done, next, ids) so a dead-man alert can carry resume state (stored on the key tier). status:"fail" reports a failure immediately.

tools.name: fetch_capsule
tools.description: Agent Flight Recorder (Gateway key) — get the last state capsule a monitored agent sent, to resume from where it died.

tools.name: fleet_status
tools.description: Agent Flight Recorder (Gateway key) — every monitor you own: alive / late / dead, last heartbeat, capsule preview.

tools.name: delete_monitor
tools.description: Agent Flight Recorder — remove a monitor (needs its secret or the owning key).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_monitor · Private data: register_monitor, delete_monitor · Public sink: register_monitor · Destructive: delete_monitor.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_monitor · Private data: register_monitor, delete_monitor · Public sink: register_monitor · Destructive: delete_monitor

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
